MATCH (e)-[:line_to]-(v:Valve)
MATCH (act:PlantItem)-[:control]->(v)
MATCH (loop:ProcessControlFunction)-[:send_signal_to*1..]->(act)
RETURN DISTINCT loop.loop_tag AS tag
ORDER BY tag

retrieval.cypher:
MATCH (a:PlantItem {tag: 'GTV-185029'}), (b:PlantItem {tag: 'XV-186002'})
MATCH p = shortestPath((a)-[:line_to*]->(b))
UNWIND range(0, size(nodes(p)) - 1) AS i
WITH nodes(p)[i] AS n, i
WHERE n:Equipment OR n:Valve
RETURN n.tag AS tag
ORDER BY i
